BackName: Mando L. Ore The Desert Templar
BackNotes:
Note of Passage for employment by the Merchant Geiss to aide a caravan of Silks and Produce from the marketplaces of Pazkanah to the city-state. Employed at 50 sp at the end of each Week .

Have been seeing a friend the Barkeep at the Cheesy Pub Tavern in Town Publuzkan to learn Common language.

Went on a caravan with the merchant and was ambushed by Bandits. Drove away the bandits but was admonished by Commander Blitz because Sir Sur thought it would be better to drive away from the battle with one of the wagons of the caravan. Sergeant Karum.

Has a fear and anger against all forms of giant insects, bugs, spiders. As a result will enthusiastically attack such monsters. Is familiar with Desert Spyider ecology.
